findings.description: Migrated JEHeaderPage, JEListPage, JEFormPage from useEffect+apiClient to React Router 7 loaders (jeHeaderLoader, jeListLoader, jeFormLoader). useLoaderData() replaces useState. useRevalidator() replaces reloadKey pattern in JEHeaderPage.

Migrated JEFormPage submit to useFetcher + jeFormAction (encType: application/json). StatusAuditPanel post button migrated to useFetcher + fetcher.submit({intent:'post-entry'}); jeHeaderAction handles post-entry intent on the JEHeaderPage route. Auto-revalidation replaces onPosted callback.

Added errors.* namespace to en.json (11 keys). All 5 hardcoded English fallback strings in LineItemsGrid replaced with t('errors.*'). Hardcoded strings in JEHeaderPage, JEListPage, JEFormPage, StatusAuditPanel eliminated by loader/action migration (errors are now thrown or returned via action data using i18n.t()). JEHeaderPage loader and jeHeaderAction use i18n.t() for fallback messages.
Added je.list.totalCount key to en.json. JEListPage now uses t('je.list.totalCount', { count: totalCount }) replacing hardcoded 'Total: ' string.
